verdict.rationale: Asana ships pre-built AI Teammates/agents (asana-docs-5,6,12,13) and Asana Dash described as an 'AI Chief of Staff' (asana-docs-8) that work within tasks/workflows with shared memory and governance, directly matching delegation of tasks to a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reviews or third-party validation of AI Teammates actually performing delegated tasks, and detail on the scope/reliability of delegation beyond vendor marketing copy.
